title: Kula Today
heading: Yesterday · Thu 12 Nov
summary: A moderate day (forecast moderate). Thermals were strongest (moderate) about 14:00 to 16:00. The upslope ran from about 08:45 to about 16:30. The evening before, the page called it normal, about 5,400 ft, a hit. Midday the base averaged about 4,800 ft by the Kekoa camera, 600 ft lower than the evening's number; the morning update said about 5,100 ft, off by 300 ft; at 10:00, from the 09:00 base, about 4,900 ft, off by 100 ft. Most of the day the shear line was crossing Kula Highway near Omaopio; furthest north about 15:52, crossing Kula Highway near Kamehameha Schools. Data gaps: no readings all day from 1 station (Nakula); the Mesonet could not be reached on 13 of 55 updates.
